text:
Maria: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we need to lock owners / timelines for the streaming endpoint issues (timeouts, partial responses, reconnect logic). Please confirm ownership here.

Ava: I can take reconnect behavior changes. Plan: implement exp backoff (base 150ms) with full jitter, cap at 25s, and a server-side cooldown mark for hot clients. Will gate behind feature flag. ETA: Mon EOD.

Leo: I'll own timeout telemetry and alerts. Will add per-route timeout histograms (p50/p95/p99) and an alert when 95th > 3s or error-rate spike. ETA: Tue AM.

Noor: I'll add partial-response detection in the proxy and emit `incomplete_chunk_rate`. Heuristics: missing final-chunk marker + EOF without terminator. Also add a small reassembly buffer for near-complete streams. ETA: Tue noon.

Carlos: I'll own validation/soak on Dedicated + Hosted after deploy. I need the chaos script and a set of test prompts / traffic profiles. I'll run canary then 1h soak.

Ava: Feature flag will be `streaming.reconnect.next`. I'll include rollback steps and a short runbook in the GH issue.

deploy-bot: Branch `reconnect-next` created and CI pipeline started for RW-4290.

Noor: FYI found a proxy edge where an upstream RESET would drop the final 408 mapping; small PR shortly.

Leo: Also adding a Grafana panel with `incomplete_chunk_rate`, `reconnect_attempts`, and `connectivity_errors` by route. Alert: if incomplete_chunk_rate > 0.5% for 15m, page oncall + postmortem channel.

Carlos: Scheduling canary for Tue 15:00 PT in `canary-007`. Will run 1h soak with simulated 5% packet loss.

Maria: Lock Tue 15:00 PT. Owners please be available for quick rollback. I'll update the postmortem and mark this thread as canonical follow-up.

Ava: Created GH issue RW-4290 and linked postmortem and runbook.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy to `canary-007` started at 2247812000.

Carlos: Canary healthy after 20m. Reconnect attempts down ~35% on sample traffic, incomplete_chunk_rate trending down. Continuing soak.

Maria: Great. Add a recurring doc to track monthly regressions of this class so we can see patterns. I'll create `incidents/streaming-regressions/monthly-check` and link it in RW-4290. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
